text:
Leo (Finance): @here New billing update going live June 1. Key changes: a new paid ‘Overage Protection’ add-on, a 48-hour billing buffer for standard metered accounts, smaller free-tier rps increases, and a shorter lifespan for promotional credits issued after the cutover. See rollout notes below.

Marta (Billing Ops): Quick explainer on Overage Protection please?

Leo (Finance): Overage Protection = $10/mo optional add-on per account that extends the buffer to 7 days, caps single-day overage charges at $25, and provides priority billing support. It does not apply to accounts with unpaid invoices or suspected abuse.

Ibrahim (Eng): How does the 48-hour buffer interact with per-key usage?

Leo (Finance): Buffer is computed and applied at the account billing level. Console will still show per-key counters and a per-key ‘soft cap’ indicator (no charge until buffer ends).

Tasha (Support): How will this show to customers on invoices and in the Console?

billing-bot: Invoice snippet example we will add: 
```
Usage: 1,050,000 tokens
Buffer protection (48h): -12,000 tokens
Overage Protection (addon): -5,000 tokens (applied if subscribed)
Billed usage: 1,033,000 tokens
One-time cap applied: $25.00 (Overage Protection)
```

legal-bot: Note: the 48-hour buffer and Overage Protection are billing conveniences. Contracts and negotiated terms are unchanged; marketplace/reseller accounts may have different treatment. Draft TOS language linked in the doc.

Ibrahim (Eng): API/webhook hooks for partners? Need header names and schema changes.

Leo (Finance): Well publish a minor OpenAPI bump. New response header: `X-RW-Buffer-Until` (ISO ts) and webhook field `usage.buffer_expires_at`. Also a companion header `X-RW-Overage-Protection: true|false`. Eng will post the diff to #eng-platform today.

Marta (Billing Ops): Promo credits change: whats the new lifetime?

Leo (Finance): Credits issued after 2026-06-01 will expire after 90 days (previously 365). Credits already issued keep their original expiry. Well show expiry dates on the Credits page and in the billing API.

Tasha (Support): Any self-serve for extending credit expiry?

Leo (Finance): Self-serve: one 14-day extension allowed via support form for qualifying startups. Larger or additional extensions require CS approval.

Ibrahim (Eng): Any free-tier rate-limit numbers?

Leo (Finance): Free-tier rate limits: text endpoints 2 -> 3 rps, embeddings 1 -> 2 rps. Were keeping this conservative. Paid/dedicated customers unaffected.

Marta (Billing Ops): New invoice minimum? We've had requests to reduce micro-invoices churn.

Leo (Finance): We will aggregate small bills and set a $5 monthly minimum for pay-as-you-go accounts; balances under $5 roll forward to the next invoice until threshold reached. This reduces card churn. (Enterprise/committed customers unaffected.)

Tasha (Support): Rollout plan for support docs and canned replies?

Leo (Finance): Timeline: internal docs + API spec posted today, Console UI flags and credits expiry display roll out in 10 days, customer emails 7 days before June 1. Support KB and canned replies to be updated by Tashas team; well host a 30-min walkthrough Wed 09:00 PT (recorded).

Ibrahim (Eng): Heads-up: partners must handle unknown webhook fields gracefully; well add versioning notes.

Marta (Billing Ops): Anything gated for fraud/unpaid balances?

Leo (Finance): Yes: buffer and Overage Protection are disabled for accounts with unpaid balances, multiple failed payments, or fraud flags. Well list exceptions in the FAQ.

Tasha (Support): Ill start drafting the customer-facing FAQ and update canned responses. Will post drafts here for review. :memo:

Leo (Finance): Thanks team. Link to draft plan + FAQ: https://redwood.internal/billing/overage-protection-jun2026. Please add comments by EOD Tue so customer emails are ready to send next week.
